name: RustTyrannomon
main_effect:
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 4＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 4 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's Digimon are deleted in battle, this Digimon may unsuspend.
